t.zh: 工件的划痕在灰图里很浅。把暗部压低、亮部抬高，看看屏幕画成同一种颜色的格子是否仍保存不同数值。 <wiki-ref to="gain-offset"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A scratch barely shows in the grey image. Lower the dark end and raise the bright end, then inspect whether cells painted the same shade still store different readings. <wiki-ref to="gain-offset"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 让 0.25 对应 0，0.75 对应 1，且等大的输入差仍对应等大的输出差。输出保留超出 0 至 1 的值。
brief.en: Map 0.25 to 0 and 0.75 to 1, keeping equal input steps equal in the output. Preserve values outside 0 to 1.

naiveWhy.zh: 放大间距之后，原来的暗端仍没有落到 0。
naiveWhy.en: After widening the spacing, the original dark endpoint still does not land on zero.

hint.zh: 先用两个标定点之间的距离确定倍率，再让其中一个点落到目标读数。
hint.en: Use the distance between the calibration points to find the gain, then align one point to its target.

after.zh: 倍率改变亮度差的大小，偏移移动整组读数。查看原始读数可以区分屏幕上看起来一样的格子。 <wiki-ref to="gain-offset"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Gain changes the size of brightness differences and offset moves all readings together. Raw readings distinguish cells that the display paints alike. <wiki-ref to="gain-offset"></wiki-ref>
